entry.author: Climate Change Commission
entry.summary:
Is NZ on track to meet its emissions reductions goals? In this webinar, Chief Executive Jo Hendy and Project Director Rob Carr dive into the Climate Change Commission's latest report. This yearly report tracks the progress the country is making towards meeting its emissions budgets and the 2050 emissions reduction target.

The full report, summaries and technical documents are available on our website: https://www.climatecommission.govt.nz/erm-2025?utm_source=youtube.com&utm_campaign=erm-2025&utm_medium=social&utm_content=webinar

You can find today's presentation slides on our Webinars page: https://www.climatecommission.govt.nz/get-involved/watch/webinars?utm_source=youtube.com&utm_campaign=erm-2025&utm_medium=social&utm_content=webinar

Sign up to get alerts about our upcoming webinars: https://confirmsubscription.com/h/t/2DB84EBFF23E1BC9

CHAPTERS:

00:00 Overview - Jo Hendy, Chief Executive
00:25 The Commission's role: what we do and why
04:04 Our approach to this year's report
05:27 How our work all fits together

07:44 Our findings - Rob Carr, Project Director
09:30 Risks
11:26 Opportunities
13:09 Recommendation
14:07 What's next?

Q&A
15:00 Can New Zealand still achieve the 2050 target?
16:06 Can New Zealand afford climate action, given high cost of living?
18:06 How the Commission's benchmarks have changed since last year's report
19:33 Do the emissions budgets meet the NDCs?
21:09 What modes of freight should be prioritised?
23:25 Shifting farming practices
25:16 What are the best ways to incentivise electrifying everything?
27:08 What policies have been considered to address electricity generation?
28:21 Is the electricity market fit for purpose (e.g. dry year risk, ease of entry for generators)?
31:50 Transport emissions are down due to the rise of working from home and the recession, but these could reverse. Was this taken into account?
32:57 How much potential is there to reduce emissions in the transport sector? Which technologies and urban design options have the greatest potential?
35:10 Military emissions
36:06 Improvements in emissions accounting methodology
37:46 Carbon capture and storage (CCS)
40:30 Forestry and forests
43:40 What's one overseas emissions reduction policy New Zealand should adopt?
45:10 Nature based solutions
46:58 Policies for improving energy efficiency
48:31 Mitigation options that could not be modelled but have potential
49:38 Any recommendations for educators at secondary school and tertiary levels?
50:39 Methane reduction opportunities
